note: Scripture source: the Open Luganda Contemporary Bible (OLCB 2017, Biblica, CC BY-SA), parsed from the ebible mirror's USX (bibles/lug_bib), all 66 books. Translators looked up every quotation (cited or not) in that verse file and copied the bytes by script.
Translated from the English as the deploy settles it (corrections.settled_chapter_body), so the library's BODY_CORRECTIONS for this slug are already in the source.

Derived by measurement: a row is mined only when the translator reported the quotation verbatim AND the block contains a 30-character run of that verse (or a quoted span of 10+ characters that is a substring of it), compared with quotation marks and punctuation stripped. adapted/self rows and 63 unconfirmed verbatim claims (mostly one-word or short-phrase echoes) are self_rendered. 126 of 380 rows mined.

Conventions: quotation marks mirror this book's English source (Luganda books never convert to guillemets); in-word apostrophe ’ as OLCB; site terms Bayibuli, Setaani, Omukristaayo; 'Mr. X' is Omwami X. A reviewer pass checked 89 trap-word sites (Kitaawe, balubaale, muzimu, mu bwangu, Mukama + surname) against the English and fixed 7 ('mu bwangu' for 'easily/simply').
